messages.subject: R's internal help server does not work with JRI
messages.subject_clean: R's internal help server does not work with JRI
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I want to use R's internal help server with JRI, but unfortunately the http connection to the help server times out. The same procedure works fine with R from console.

To reproduce this issue run "rtest" by executing "./run rtest" from directory  "rJava/jri". Then start the help server:

> help.start()
 starting httpd help server ... done

If no web browser was opened by that time, do generate a url for a help page using the following command. Then try to navigate to the generated help url.

> paste0("http://127.0.0.1:", tools::startDynamicHelp(NA), "/library/utils/html/00Index.html", collapse='')
 [1] "http://127.0.0.1:17939/library/utils/html/00Index.html"

Within Activitiy Monitor.app I can see that the process is listening on the opened port, but the http connection times out without any response.

Is there any solution for this issue? Thanks in advance.

Best regards,

Alex

messages.subject: capturing rJava console output
messages.body_plain:
Bottom line up front: how can I capture console output from java that 
isn’t a proper message or a returned character string?

I’m working with the |rkafka| 
<https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/rkafka/index.html> package 
which depends on |rJava|. Unfortunately, some of the java code behind 
rkafka is dumping warnings and errors to the console and gives no 
indication in the returned value.

Sample code (after object instantiation):

    |library(rkafka) obj <- rkafka.createProducer("localhost:9092") INFO:
    Remember to close the Producer after done sending messages x <-
    capture.output(rkafka.send(obj, topicName = "test", message =
    jsonlite::toJSON(list(a=1,b=2)))) Failed to send message after three
    tries. Check ip address passed and if zookeeper and kafka server are
    running kafka.common.FailedToSendMessageException: Failed to send
    messages after 3 tries. at
    kafka.producer.async.DefaultEventHandler.handle(DefaultEventHandler.scala:90)
    at kafka.producer.Producer.send(Producer.scala:76) at
    kafka.javaapi.producer.Producer.send(Producer.scala:33) at
    com.musigma.producer.MuProducer.sendMessage(MuProducer.java:68) |

Using |capture.output| or |purrr::quietly| still returns nothing, and 
the message is on the console, not captured.

This is likely not specific to |rkafka|, but I don’t have a reproducible 
example with another module. I don’t need help with the kafka 
connection, that’s not my question (though if somebody knows of another 
way to access kafka from R, I’m all ears). I know that the code works 
fine when there aren’t connection errors, but when a problem happens I 
get a |NULL|, and if I’m not watching the console, then I don’t know 
something went wrong.

I sit possible to capture the console output without having to change 
the java module code itself?

Thoughts?

Bill
